description:
The Bunny Who Never Shared His Crayons: The Colorful Masterp — Benny the bunny had the ultimate 64-crayon pack with a sharpener, but wouldn't let anyone use his sky blue crayon!
Kids science answer for "sharing crayons kindergarten moral story" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Hoarding colors only gives you one shade of painting; pooling crayons together lets a whole group create a glorious rainbow mural.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
